name: benchmark-artifact-3
argv:
if [ "$BENCHMARK_SUITE" = memory_evolution_runtime_v1 ]; then
  runner=(python -m tests.support.run_memory_evolution_runtime_benchmark)
else
  runner=(python -m memorii.tools.run_eval)
fi
"${runner[@]}" \
  --suite "$BENCHMARK_SUITE" \
  --mode "$BENCHMARK_MODE" \
  --dry-run \
  --fail-on-benchmark-failure \
  --storage-root /private/tmp/scoped-context-final-gates/artifact-3 \
  --sim-profile "$BENCHMARK_PROFILE" \
  --sim-scenario-count "$BENCHMARK_COUNT" \
  --sim-noise-rate 0.35 \
  --seed 7 \
  $BENCHMARK_EXTRA
python -m memorii.tools.validate_benchmark_artifacts \
  --root /private/tmp/scoped-context-final-gates/artifact-3/benchmark_runs \
  --suite "$BENCHMARK_SUITE"
